reviews.title: Um, full moon not tonight
reviews.text: Your notifications have gotten ridiculous over these last months sending double at a time. But tonight I get one that says full moon is tonight. The full moon is in 11 days. Of all the apps to get this wrong, this one shouldn’t be one of them.

reviews.title: Was brilliant
reviews.text: Brought this app years ago, have loved it, but now I have to deal with adverts, a lot of adverts, I’m using same Apple account when I originally purchased it. Cannot find a way to restore purchases on app. So after over 10 years, think I will have to finally delete it.

reviews.title: Paid Version is no different than free version
reviews.text: I subscribed / paid for a year and nothing has changed from the free version. Still full of ads , still can not view deep space objects or satellites. I can not get any customer support or a refund. It should be rated negative stars

reviews.title: 카메라와 AR기능이 작동하지 않음
reviews.text:
아이폰14 최신 업데이트 사용자이고 앱실행시 제목처럼 작동하지 않았어요. 
첫구동시 앱이 워하는 위치와 알림 모두 허용했습니다. 
초반에 잠시 보이다가 카메라 ui와 자이로ui 모두 화면에서 사라졌습니다.
재설치를 해봤지만 그후로는앱화면에서 ui가 나타나지 않았고 아이폰 설정의 앱설정에서 카메라허용이 사라졌습니다.

reviews.title: New Version Is Worse
reviews.text:
I used to like Star Walk, even with the super annoying “music”.  The new version doesn’t even work - it does not respond to phone movements, so you have to move the screen around with finger gestures.

The addition of ads completely ruins it.  Delete.

reviews.title: Bug
reviews.text: When I click on an object it doesn’t let me exit the object so now I have to completely reload the app to click on another object I don’t know if it’s just in iPad problem but it doesn’t work

reviews.title: Free version is awful
reviews.text: If I can get the app to run it seems very good, but I click something and I get a 15 second ad. I return to the main screen zoom in on a star and get a 15 second ad. I want to give this app a try but when I can’t even fully test drive it why would I want to pay for it.

reviews.title: Abo Slop
reviews.text: Wie bei allen anderen unterdurchschnittlichen Apps auch. Funktionen hinter die Abopaywall schieben. Sorry ihr wart eine der besten Apps aber dieses Verhalten werde ich nicht unterstützen und schon gar nicht zu diesen Preisen.

reviews.title: Gruwelijk veel reclame
reviews.text: Vroeger was deze app echt helemaal geweldig, heel wat avonden mee naar de hemel gekeken, tegenwoordig bij elke beweging/aanraking krijg je reclame…

reviews.title: It will show the stars
reviews.text: This free app sucks. You can’t get any info before an add. Then after 30 sec. maybe you will get the X to close the add then before you can find something you bet another add.

reviews.title: It was good app before
reviews.text: Earlier few years ago i purchaes app and was good working. Now when you zoom in all advertisements came out and freeze map after that, basically not working. I wouldn’t trust any version of starwalking anymore

reviews.title: Great! …in theory…
reviews.text:
Great app, in theory. I understand having adds in the free version of the app, but they will hit you with multiple adds within 30 seconds of the last one, making it IMPOSSIBLE to even attempt to use.

Update to respond to their response: it most DEFINITELY did! I would gladly post a screen recording of it here if I could! How dare you lie like this. NEVER doing business with people of suck low ethical standards.

reviews.title: Don’t subscribe by mistake.
reviews.text: I Star-walked straight into a subscription that I don’t want. There are no instructions that tell me how to cancel the subscription that I don’t want. Dodgy behaviour from the developer of a questionable app. Unhelpful and manipulative.

reviews.title: Good but...
reviews.text: So I was just looking at other planets with my telescope but then I got an commercial and I shouldn't have gotten that because when NASA is trying to look for something and a commercial comes up they will not  be in a mood for watching it

reviews.title: Do Not DOWNLOAD
reviews.text: Omg nooooo.  Can’t see anything.  Ads popping up. Ugh. Was good terrible now.
